title: Skill routing manifest (schema_version 1)
description: Per-skill routing data consumed by scripts/generate-routing.sh to emit host-native routing fragments. Replaces hand-maintained CLAUDE.md prose for invocation rules.

name.description: Kebab-case skill identifier; must match the SKILL.md frontmatter name.

triggers.description: Natural-language phrases that fire this skill in conversation.

default_mode.description: Router skills only; mode pack to dispatch when no arg or default intent.

domains.description: Tag set used by per-project .skill-domains filtering. Empty = always loaded.

skip_when.description: Loading rules. By default, skill is omitted from routing when none of its domains match the project's .skill-domains.
